en.title: Dinner in the hall
en.lead: The bar has refrigerated displays and glassware, and there is a coffee machine and a dishwasher on site.

en.title: The evening goes on
en.lead: The audio system, the karaoke and the party lighting are all on site.
en.body: The hosts offer the hall for birthdays, anniversaries and weddings. Their current website carries neither a telephone number nor an address, so contact means calling in person.
